sources.name: BusElche / Avanza official route pages for Lines G and I
Current AliBus ordered G and I stop pages with municipal stop codes and map coordinates
Accepted A/B/C, D/F/H and E/J scenarios used for exact shared StopNode and StopPlace reuse

transformations.description: Combines each line's ordered outbound and return lists into one complete cycle. Repeated Hospital Vinalopó handoff and Centro cycle-boundary occurrences are removed, and closesLoop=true adds the final edge once.
Uses the municipal stop code as the stable elche-stop and elche-place suffix. Accepted identities from earlier Elche scenarios are copied exactly.
Creates one strict parser-compatible StopPlace for every new directional StopNode. No proximity-only physical merges are made.
Writes established scenario assets, computes asset SHA-256 values and aggregate contentHash, and registers the scenario.

warnings: Runtime StopNode sourceReferences remain empty for new nodes because that field accepts only genuine OpenStreetMap platform or stop_position components. Municipal codes and AliBus coordinate links remain build provenance.
Accepted StopNode and StopPlace objects reused from earlier Elche scenarios retain their exact previous bytes and coordinates.
G and I are explicit circular patterns. The first StopNode is not repeated at the end; closesLoop=true adds the closing edge exactly once.
Physical StopPlace creation does not create route edges, reverse patterns, or cross-pattern graph edges.
Hospital Vinalopó is represented by the same stable directional StopNode and singleton StopPlace in G and I. Later K/L discovery must reuse this identity rather than create a route-specific copy.
